name: TopbarSearch

props.description: The step below which the field folds to a TopbarItem search cell (sm 40rem · md 48rem · lg 64rem · xl 80rem). CSS decides at the step, so SSR and the first paint agree and the typed query survives a resize.
props.name: collapseBelow

props.description: The search's accessible name — the field's AND the folded cell's. Defaults to the localized "Search". Name the scope ("Search this collection").
props.name: ariaLabel

props.description: Every SearchInput prop passes through unchanged: value / defaultValue / onValueChange, onSearch, placeholder, debounce, shortcut, status, disabled.
props.name: …SearchInputProp

related: Topbar (the slot bar it belongs to)
CommandPalette (⌘K jump-to; a different task from searching content)
tagline: The bar's one search box. From 40rem up an inline SearchInput whose text area never shrinks below 8ch; below it a named search cell that opens the field across the whole bar (Material 3 search bar → search view). Escape or the close cell folds it and returns focus to the cell.
usage: DO use it for the search in a Topbar slot instead of a bare SearchInput: a SearchInput there shrinks with the cluster (0ch of text at 390px, measured in a consumer bar).
DO name the scope in `ariaLabel`; it is the folded cell's only name.
DO put it FIRST in `Topbar start` under the default `topbarSpan="content"` when the search belongs to the page column: it then starts on the content keyline (0px apart at 1280).
DON'T also render a separate search icon button for phones — the folded cell IS that button.

Keyboard: Enter/Space on the cell opens and focuses the field; Escape closes and returns focus; Tab out of the open field folds it and leaves focus where it went. The cell is an APG disclosure (aria-expanded / aria-controls).
useCases: A collection or workspace search in the app bar
A global search that must survive a 320–390px phone bar
